scenario: A dashboard must load quickly and work offline from a large database. Which connection type fits?

options.text: A live connection with no caching
options.note: Depends on the database being reachable and fast.
A connection method, not offline storage.
Limits data; not a connection type.

explanation: Extracts (.hyper files) are snapshots that can be refreshed on a schedule.

scenario: When should a live connection be used instead of an extract?

options.text: When users need up-to-the-minute data from a fast database
When analysts must work offline while traveling
When the database is slow and overloaded

explanation: Live connections query the source each time the view changes.

scenario: Which method combines two tables with the same columns, like monthly sales files, into one longer table?

options.note: Combines sources at the aggregate level.

explanation: Wildcard unions can combine many files that match a pattern.

scenario: In Tableau's data model, what's the default way to combine tables in the logical layer?
explanation: Relationships keep tables separate and join them only as needed for each view.

scenario: Which join returns only rows that have matching values in both tables?

options.note: Keeps all rows from the left.
Keeps all rows from the right.

explanation: Joins are defined in the physical layer by double-clicking a logical table.

scenario: Which technique combines data from two different data sources at the aggregate level on a sheet?

options.note: Combines rows from the same structure.

explanation: The primary source shows a blue check; secondary sources show an orange check.

scenario: A spreadsheet has extra title rows and merged headers. Which feature can clean it automatically?
explanation: Review the results Data Interpreter produces.

scenario: Monthly sales are stored as separate columns (Jan, Feb, Mar). What should be done for easier analysis?

options.text: Create a set from the columns
options.note: Sets group members of a dimension.

explanation: Pivoting produces a Month field and a Sales value field.

scenario: Which filter limits the data available to every sheet that uses a data source?
explanation: Extract filters reduce what is stored in the extract.

scenario: In Tableau's order of operations, which filter is applied first?
explanation: Order: extract, data source, context, FIXED LOD, dimension, INCLUDE/EXCLUDE, measure, table calc filters.

scenario: Which feature splits a 'Full Name' field into First and Last name fields?
explanation: Split uses separators like spaces or commas.

scenario: A field with ZIP codes was imported as a number. What should be changed?

options.text: Its data type and geographic role
Its default aggregation from SUM to AVG

explanation: Assigning a ZIP Code geographic role enables map plotting.

scenario: Which feature changes how a dimension's members are displayed without changing the data, like 'NY' to 'New York'?
explanation: Aliases are set by right-clicking a field and choosing Aliases.

scenario: Which file type packages a workbook with its local data and images so others can open it?
explanation: Use .twbx when sharing with people who can't reach your data.

scenario: Which feature restricts each salesperson to seeing only their own rows when publishing?
explanation: User functions like USERNAME() support row-level security.

scenario: When does an extract refresh pull new data?

options.text: When refreshed manually or on a schedule
Every time a mark is clicked
Only when Tableau Desktop is reinstalled or updated

explanation: Incremental refreshes add only new rows based on a field.

scenario: Which field type do numeric fields like Sales usually become when connecting to data?
explanation: You can convert fields between dimensions and measures.

scenario: Which tool is designed for cleaning and shaping data before analysis in a visual flow?
explanation: Prep flows can output extracts or published data sources.

scenario: Blue pills in a Tableau view indicate which kind of field?
explanation: Discrete fields create headers; continuous fields create axes.

scenario: What does placing a continuous field on Columns create?
explanation: Continuous dates create a timeline axis.

scenario: What is the default aggregation for a numeric measure like Sales?
explanation: Change aggregation by right-clicking the pill.

scenario: Which Marks card property adds a field so marks are split without changing color or size?
explanation: Detail increases the level of detail of the view.

scenario: Which chart type is best for comparing sales across product categories?
explanation: Sort bars to make comparisons easier.

scenario: Which chart shows the relationship between Sales and Profit for each customer?
explanation: Add a trend line from the Analytics pane.

scenario: Which feature creates a histogram by grouping a measure into equal ranges?
explanation: Right-click a measure and choose Create > Bins.

scenario: Which feature combines dimension members, like merging 'NY' and 'New York' into one?
explanation: Groups can also be created by selecting marks in a view.

scenario: Which feature defines a custom subset of data, like Top 10 customers by sales, that can be used in/out of the set?
explanation: Sets can be fixed or dynamic and support set actions.

scenario: Which feature lets users enter a value, like a target, that calculations can use?
explanation: Show the parameter control so users can change it.

scenario: Which calculation returns the number of days between Order Date and Ship Date?
explanation: The order of the dates determines the sign of the result.

scenario: Which function replaces NULL numeric values with zero?
explanation: IFNULL(expr, value) replaces NULL with any value.

scenario: Which LOD expression computes total sales per customer regardless of other dimensions in the view?

options.note: Adds Customer to the view level.
Removes Customer from the view level.

explanation: FIXED ignores view dimensions and is computed before dimension filters.

scenario: Which LOD expression removes a dimension from the view's level of detail, like computing region totals in a state view?
explanation: EXCLUDE is computed after dimension filters.

scenario: Which quick table calculation shows each category's share of the total?
explanation: Check Compute Using to control the direction.

scenario: A running total restarts in each region, but the user wants one continuous total. What should be changed?

options.text: The table calculation's Compute Using setting
The color palette assigned to Region

explanation: Table calculations compute along chosen dimensions (addressing) and restart per partition.

scenario: Which filter should be made a context filter so a Top 10 filter is applied within a selected region?

options.note: It should be evaluated after context.

explanation: Context filters are applied before Top N and FIXED LOD calculations.

scenario: Which Analytics pane item shows the average sales across the view?
explanation: Reference lines, bands and distributions summarize data.

scenario: Which Analytics pane feature predicts future values on a time series?

options.note: Fits a model to existing data.

explanation: Forecasting uses exponential smoothing models.

scenario: Which Analytics pane feature groups marks into similar segments automatically?
explanation: Tableau uses k-means clustering.

scenario: Which feature puts two measures on the same chart with separate axes, like bars for Sales and a line for Profit?
explanation: Synchronize axes when the measures use the same scale.

scenario: Order Date is placed on Columns as the discrete date part MONTH. What does the view show?

options.text: A discrete date part that groups all years' months together
A continuous date value for each month and year
A set containing the selected months

explanation: Date values (continuous) keep each month-year separate.

scenario: Which calculation returns 'High' when Sales > 1000 and 'Low' otherwise?
explanation: IIF() is a shorter alternative for simple conditions.

scenario: Which sort option orders bars by the value of a measure?
explanation: Use the sort buttons in the toolbar for quick sorts.

scenario: Which filter shows the top 5 products by profit?

options.text: A Top N filter on the Product dimension
A data source filter on Product
A highlight action on the five largest marks

explanation: Use a parameter to let users change N.

scenario: Which feature creates a drill-down from Category to Sub-Category in a view?
explanation: Click the + on the pill to drill down.

scenario: Which Measure Names/Measure Values approach shows several measures in one table?

options.text: Put Measure Names on Rows and Measure Values on Text
Create a parameter for each measure
Use a data source filter on each measure

explanation: Measure Values holds all measures in one field.

scenario: Which mark type is best for a map showing sales by state as filled areas?
explanation: Symbol maps use circles sized by a measure.

scenario: Which chart type is best for showing project tasks with start dates and durations?
explanation: Put duration on Size with a Gantt Bar mark.

scenario: Which table calculation function ranks products by sales within the view?
explanation: RANK variants include RANK_DENSE and RANK_UNIQUE.

scenario: Which dashboard object arranges sheets so they resize together and don't overlap?
explanation: Horizontal and vertical containers keep layouts tidy.

scenario: Which dashboard action lets clicking a bar filter other sheets?

options.note: Emphasizes related marks without removing data.

explanation: Actions can run on select, hover or menu.

scenario: Which action emphasizes related marks in other sheets while keeping all data visible?
explanation: Highlighting helps users see relationships.

scenario: Which action opens a web page with details about the selected product?
explanation: URL actions can insert field values into the link.

scenario: Which action lets clicking a mark change a parameter's value?
explanation: Parameter actions enable interactive what-if analysis.

scenario: Which feature presents a sequence of sheets or dashboards to tell a data story?
explanation: Each story point captures a view with a caption.

scenario: How can a dashboard be optimized for phones?
explanation: Device Designer previews desktop, tablet and phone layouts.

scenario: Which dashboard sizing option adapts to the viewer's window?
explanation: Fixed sizes can render faster because they're cached.

scenario: Where can a workbook be published so anyone on the internet can view it for free?
explanation: Don't publish sensitive data to Tableau Public.

scenario: Which export option gives a stakeholder the data behind a view in a spreadsheet?
explanation: Download options depend on permissions when published.

scenario: Which tooltip feature shows a mini chart when hovering over a mark?
explanation: Insert a sheet into the tooltip from the Tooltip editor.

scenario: Which feature lets users subscribe to receive a dashboard snapshot by email on a schedule?

options.text: Subscriptions on Tableau Cloud or Server

explanation: Data-driven alerts notify users when values cross thresholds.

scenario: Which dashboard object adds space between items to improve layout?
explanation: Padding settings also control spacing.

scenario: Which object lets users move between dashboards with a click?
explanation: Go to Sheet actions can do this from marks too.

scenario: A filter should apply to all sheets on a dashboard that use the same data source. What's the setting?

options.text: Apply to Worksheets > All Using This Data Source

explanation: Related data sources can also share filters.

scenario: Which file format is best for sharing a static, printable version of a dashboard?
explanation: PowerPoint export is also available.

scenario: Which feature lets viewers on Tableau Cloud ask questions or get AI summaries of metrics?

options.note: Shows charts on hover, not AI insights.

explanation: Tableau Pulse delivers metric insights in natural language.

scenario: Which dashboard practice improves readability?

options.text: Limit the number of views and use clear titles
Pack as many charts as possible

explanation: Place the most important view at the top left.

scenario: Which permission determines whether a viewer can download a workbook from Tableau Cloud?
explanation: Site roles and project permissions control capabilities.

scenario: Which feature lets a user save a custom version of a published dashboard with their filters applied?
explanation: Custom views can be set as the user's default.

scenario: Which product is used to author workbooks on a computer?
explanation: Tableau Cloud also supports web authoring.

scenario: Which offering is Tableau's fully hosted SaaS platform for sharing content?
explanation: Tableau Cloud was formerly called Tableau Online.

scenario: What's the difference between dimensions and measures?

options.text: Dimensions categorize; measures are numbers you aggregate
They're identical except for pill color

explanation: Dimensions often determine the view's level of detail.

scenario: Which engine powers fast extracts in Tableau?
explanation: Hyper is an in-memory data engine optimized for analytics.

scenario: Which tool keeps Tableau Cloud connected to data behind a company firewall?
explanation: Bridge refreshes extracts and supports live queries to private data.

scenario: Which data type is assigned to a field with values like 2026-10-28?
explanation: Date & time fields also include a time component.

scenario: What does a green pill with an axis usually represent?

options.note: Not shown as pills this way.

explanation: Continuous measures and dates create axes.

scenario: Which is a benefit of publishing a data source separately to Tableau Cloud?

options.text: Many workbooks can reuse one governed source
It makes the data public on the internet automatically
It removes the need for permissions

explanation: Certified data sources signal trusted content.

scenario: What does ATTR() return when a field has more than one value for a mark?
explanation: ATTR returns the value if all rows match; otherwise *.

scenario: Which file stores only the workbook's structure and references external data?
explanation: Share .twbx when recipients can't reach the data.

scenario: Which Tableau component determines the level of detail of a view?

options.text: The dimensions in the view (rows, columns, marks)
The color palette and font choices

explanation: Adding a dimension to Detail increases granularity.

scenario: Which field is created automatically for every data source and counts rows?
explanation: Older versions showed a Number of Records field.
